review_evidence: README describes a tool that animates Lean proofs, but the source snapshot includes a substantial Input/ formalization collection rather than only rendering/tool code.
Ten of 16 Lean files contain 36 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations.

Input/Imo2024P2.lean formalizes IMO 2024 Problem 2, while Input/NNG.lean and Input/Digits.lean contain reusable arithmetic results; retiring the whole source would lose unique formal statements/proofs.
summary: Reviewed animate-lean-proofs; retain because the animation tool repository also contains nontrivial theorem formalizations used as its inputs.
